briefing: COP31 climate talks in Turkey are deadlocked over fossil fuels, and UN talks on killer robots ended without binding rules. Nasdaq fell 10% for the week as the AI boom showed strain, with Anthropic closing near its IPO price. A judge approved a $7.25bn Roundup settlement, and the UK and EU agreed a trade deal. A jury convicted the man behind the Palisades Fire. In Idaho, a state report tied prison growth to drug charges.

sections.name: World and US
sections.brief: COP31 talks are deadlocked over fossil fuels. UN talks on killer robots ended without binding rules.

articles.headline: COP31 climate talks deadlocked over fossil fuels
articles.summary: Talks in Turkey ran past their deadline as nations split on fossil fuel language.

articles.headline: UN talks on killer robots end with no binding rules
articles.summary: Countries get two years to propose rules, which may not be legally binding.

articles.headline: Zelensky defends Crimean Bridge strikes as a fair response
articles.summary: He says Russia attacked bridges in Ukraine 109 times and wants a reason to escalate.

articles.headline: Jury convicts man of starting the deadly Palisades Fire
articles.summary: Jonathan Rinderknecht was found guilty on both federal counts after an earlier mistrial.

articles.headline: Mexican cartel boss on FBI most wanted list arrested
articles.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was captured after a shoot-out in Sinaloa.

sections.name: Tech and AI
sections.brief: Outages tied to AI-era patching strain; a leak test hits AI routers. Anthropic faces its safety test.

articles.headline: Wired: the recent tech outages may be a sign of more to come
articles.summary: Experts say AI-driven bug hunting is straining patching, not that AI caused the outages.

articles.headline: Test with 2 million decoy secrets finds leaks in AI routers
articles.summary: Researcher HD Moore says some AI providers were compromised or ignored privacy flags.

articles.headline: House Intel chair-elect threatens SpaceX funding over Starshield
articles.summary: Rep. Jim Himes cites SpaceX service changes in Ukraine and slow answers to Congress.

articles.headline: Anthropic faces test of its safety pledge as a public company
articles.summary: Critics ask if shareholder pressure could shape decisions about risky models.

articles.headline: Startup sues Apple in India over NameDrop contact sharing
articles.summary: GG Technologies seeks about $162 million and an injunction in Bombay High Court.

sections.name: Business and Healthcare
sections.brief: The Nasdaq fell 10% in a week. A $7.25bn Roundup settlement won approval, and the UK and EU struck a deal.

articles.headline: Nasdaq drops 10% in a week as AI boom shows strain
articles.summary: The S&P 500 and Dow both closed in correction territory.

articles.headline: Judge approves $7.25bn Roundup cancer settlement
articles.summary: Bayer will pay into a fund for up to 21 years for current and future claimants.

articles.headline: UK and EU agree trade deal; Burnham sees up to 17bn pounds a year
articles.summary: The deal scraps most food export checks and adds a youth experience scheme.

articles.headline: GTA 6 takes in $3.8bn in its first full day, a record
articles.summary: Take-Two says it is the biggest entertainment launch ever.

articles.headline: Airbnb limits chores hosts can demand of guests
articles.summary: Some hosts say the new rules could push cleaning costs onto customers.

sections.name: Idaho
sections.brief: Caldwell lights up for Winter Wonderland. A state report ties prison growth to drug charges.

articles.headline: Caldwell Winter Wonderland opens, drawing Treasure Valley families
articles.summary: The annual festival has lit up downtown after months of preparation.

articles.headline: Report: drug charges drive Idaho prison growth
articles.summary: State watchdog says Idaho jails women at the nation's highest rate.

articles.headline: Veterans oppose House benefits bill, citing disability cuts
articles.summary: The Take Care of America's Veterans Act trims some future disability support.

articles.headline: Trump says he will veto bills but sees room for deal on healthcare
articles.summary: He expects many vetoes from a Democratic Congress, then talks.
